asset_findings.evidence_notes: Actually inspected the exact 1440x1040 PNG using view_image in this canonical writer context. The single nominal 10-year Treasury par-yield series uses percent, January 2-November 4, 2026. Code compared all 212 point dates and values against the exact admitted official text; the final 4.90% and prior 4.95% imply a Decimal change of minus 5.00 basis points. The visible early-year low, autumn high and final decline agree with that series. Line geometry uses a clearly labelled nonzero percent scale appropriate for comparing yield levels; there are no bars, stacks, totals, currency conversion, second axis, Bitcoin overlay or extrapolated observations. Labels, legend, source and window are legible at original size. Reported-date connectors do not fabricate weekend observations. The full source-linked caption says this is Treasury yields rather than Bitcoin performance. Mobile embedding is compact; key dates, 4.90% and the source are also supplied in readable surrounding prose/caption.

Actually inspected the original 3000x2041 JPEG using view_image, then both canonical renditions. The sharp pale-stone facade, central entrance, flagpole, sky and lawn agree with the retained Eccles Building identity. March 2011 is explicitly labelled archive context, with full Federal Reserve Board/Federalreserve via Wikimedia Commons/public-domain credit on the canonical article. The supplied exact rights evidence identifies a Board of Governors work under the PD-USGov-Federal Reserve template; it does not infer rights from regional Reserve Banks or from agency text. Identity/date/authorship derive from that retained record rather than the pixels. Original and rights hashes were already checked in this same role; the bound JPEG remains unchanged. The photo is secondary macro context, makes no Bitcoin/current-meeting/demand claim and is not used by the eight social image selections.
